Small amount for the price but it does help a tiny tiny bit. Which is rare for an eye cream in my experience. It is hydrating and I think it's cute how it matches the other products in the line. If it was a larger jar for the same price I'd definitely recommend it.

avis.titre: Hydrates and tones the eye area while leaving skin
avis.texte: This eye gel cream feels so refreshing and lightweight. It hydrates the delicate skin around the eyes really well and leaves it looking smoother and more toned. I've noticed that it helps reduce puffiness in the morning, and the caffeine gives a nice energizing effect. The texture absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, making it perfect for daily use

avis.titre: Refreshing eye gel that hydrates, smooths, and red
avis.texte: This eye gel cream has such a refreshing texture! It absorbs quickly without leaving any residue, making it perfect under makeup or alone. The caffeine helps reduce puffiness in the morning, while the hydration keeps my under-eye area smooth and plump throughout the day. I also appreciate that it's lightweight and gentle, with sleek packaging that's easy to use daily.

I was first introduced to this eye cream through Influenster and I've repurchased it many times since. It glides so smoothly over my undereye area and feels like a small treat every time I use it. Best of all, it works fast and really does depuff my undereye area almost immediately. A little goes a long way. It's become a must-have in my skincare lineup.

Im not sensitive under my eyes and when i saw this was fragrance free i was really excited but this eye cream did nothing!!!!! It didnt make me look awake or help with my dark circles and everytime i put it on my eyes would get sooo watery!

I loveee this product. the texture is like gel and it makes my under eyes super moisturized and feeling away. The packaging is nice and the scent is fresh. I love it. Clean ingredients and didn't irritate my sensitive skin at all

avis.titre: Maybe the best eye gel I've tried
avis.texte: Of late, I've relied on Clinique All About Eyes Rich cream for daytime under makeup, but I was looking for something more affordable for night. My dermatologist recommends Neutrogena Hydro Boost products and after reading the great reviews, I decided to try it. After about a week of use, I'm very happy with the results. Reduces the flaking on the outside corners of my eyes and softens the wrinkles. Have used it twice a day when I'm more dry. This looks like a new fave!
When you need a quick boost under the eyes, because let's face it, mommying is exhausting.. this is the perfect go to. Lightweight and good texture. Gives my face the quick refresh it needs.

avis.titre: i did not have good results with this product
avis.texte: i am sorry to say that after using about 3/4 of the jar, i have seen no difference whatsoever. this product is probably more designed for someone to start using before they have eye bags, as opposed to expecting it to reduce/eliminate them.

I never really used eye creams, but after the results I got from the Hydro Boost moisturizer, I thought to give this eye gel a try since I often have puffiness around my eyes in the morning. It works like a dream and now I can't go without it! I see the puffiness go away within minutes of applying. Thank you so much!
This is probably great if you dont have sensitive skin, but unfortunately it burns and stings- not only immediately when applying, but for hours afterwards if you don't wash it off.

I just used this product for under my eyes, and I felt great using it. It's a light, non-greasy formula. There's no scent for those with sensitive skin or prone to breakouts. It's small, but you don't need a lot.
Such a great product love the simple of the packaging. Love the ingredients plus it has caffeine. it's under eyes i also love that I hydrate em plums and boost up your on the eyes, very absorbent
The ingredients on this were pretty nice, but I found that it peeled up quite a bit so that is not my favorite thing in the whole world. Other than that, this is fine.
I didn't notice much of a difference with the cream. The texture was great and my skin absorbed it pretty quick! Just really didn't notice a difference.

It does nothing for me. I made a purchase with my own money. it wasn't gifted for a review in exchange. this is suppose to help with dark circles but it does not. i'm frankly tired of these companies making baseless claims. I'M TIRED OF BEING DISAPPOINTED not being able to get a refund.

I love when I get to try great drugstore products that most people can actually afford, as opposed to premium brands, which are also fun to try, but not always affordable. This is a great eye cream option that really wakes you up and has a great texture that is smooth.

avis.titre: Nice eye gel for dark circles and puffiness
avis.texte: I actually really love this eye gel cream! It's fragrance free and reduces the look of dark circles and puffiness! I noticed a difference almost immediately. The texture of the cream is very gel like and the packaging is cute I can carry it with me!

This stuff wasn't the best thing ever but it also wasn't the worst. My biggest issues with it was that it didn't give me any results. I did almost the whole thing and nothing. Could just be a me issue. Secondly I didn't like how it made my under eyes feel. Again probably just a me thing. Overall it's worth a try for someone who is on a budget
Love Neutrogena and love this eye cream. I especially appreciate that it's fragrance free. The caffeine boost is a fantastic addition for my tired mom eyes!

I bought this initially for myself and then after letting one of my family members try it… it mysteriously disappeared ;). Since repurchasing, this product continues to do wonders for my under eyes giving me that *I got 8 hours of sleep* look when I most definitely did not. It is super hydrating and leaves an awakened glow!
This product was very moisturizing and long-lasting! It truly surged moisture into my skin, especially when winter is taking so much! I definitely recommend it!

I have enjoyed this hydrating eye balm for over a month now. I can tell the effectiveness of the caffeine works because once applied it does make my eyes feel more wide and awake as well as visibly being able to see the hydration on my skin. I don't really notice it doing much for puffy or darkness but that's not a deal breaker for me. It is pricey for a small amount but a little bit of this really goes a long way. Would recommend!
My fav product in the morning routine, helps with puffiness eyes, making your skin more fresh and good looking. I have tiny packaging, but it's enough, you need just apply under eyes zone.
A little goes a long way but I love how my eyes don't have dark circles anymore

Okay, this cream actually blew me away. I am a mom of two, so I am always running short on sleep & have dark eye bags every morning. Withing minutes of using this cream, there is a noticeable improvement in the color and puffiness under my eyes. It's actually wild to see how stark the difference is. The container is small, but you literally need the tiniest amount, so I still think it will last me quite a while. The only thing I didn't love was that there is a VERY slight warming sensation for a little while after applying the cream. I'm sure that's just the caffeine doing its thing, but it's worth mentioning. Either way, it's a worthy price to pay for how well it works. Highly highly recommend!

I have acne prone, combo, light skin and have some darkness under my eyes. This product did not irritate my eye area/my eyes nor cause any breakouts, which is a good start. I also appreciate how it does not contain fragrance (as fragrance near my eyes could potentially be irritating). The cream itself is more like a gel-cream consistency, it is lightweight and absorbs easily, while providing a light-medium level of hydration. It does not interfere with my other skincare products or makeup worn over it. I do not notice any immediate effects of reducing darkness or puffiness around my eyes, but the areas look subtly more hydrated. I think I will need to use it a bit more to see longer-term effects. Overall, I find this eye cream easy to use (which is quite important for me to continue use of the product) with no adverse side effects for me and I will continue to use it to keep the skin around my eyes well-moisturized (and in hopes to reduce darkness).

This is a great basic, hydrating and de-puffing eye cream that is lightweight and does not irritate the delicate skin around the eye. I didn't notice any long-lasting effects, and I don't expect to see any changes in dark circles but it is great for a quick pick-me-up while getting ready in the morning.
I have been using this cream for a week as my daytime lotion and it's fantastic, and I will likely purchase this in the future. It's a thinner cream that feels very watery without being runny at all.
I like it . Fragrance free .great product. I hope it will reduce the puffiness.I'm starting to see the difference in my dark circles

avis.titre: Nutrigena hydro boost caffeine eye gel
avis.texte: I write this product 5 star review. The neutrogena Hydro boost caffeine, eye gel cream is lightweight.Non greasy perfect under makeup. Supper absorbing . Feels great opens your eyes bright and beautiful

I truly enjoy using this product. It has reduced my puffiness and the dryness around the corners of my eyes. I have not noticed any changes in the creases in the corner of my eyes. The dark color of my eyes has also been reduced.

avis.titre: Didn't notice much of a difference

i have been using this eye cream day and night while I havent noticed a huge difference I am pleased that it dorsnt sting my eyes or make them feel sensative like other eye creams
This product is amazing! It goes on smooth and my skin absorbs it right away. It's not sticky so there's no sweating. You can see a difference right away! I would absolutely recommend this!
I have fine lines under my eyes and this product has worked wonders! The caffeine really helps to plump that delicate skin! This does not irritate my eyes at all! Looks amazing under makeup!
I would certainly recommend this to anyone struggling with dark ,puffy, and or tired eyes. the cream is light and refreshing and easy to apply. Left my face feeling and looking more energetic.
I have been in the market for a new moisturizer and this was perfect, especially in the colder, drier months. This left my skin feeling nourished but not oily or too heavy.

I like this product overall! It feels good to apply and my under eye area feels moisturized and healthy. The dark circles under my eyes look a little bit better - I didn't experience a revolutionary difference enough to give a full 5 stars, but I'm still pretty happy with the result and would purchase again.

avis.titre: I hope it will start working
avis.texte: This eye cream is very lightweight and absorbs into the skin nicely leaving no residue. A little goes a very long way, so even though it's a small container I do see this lasting a long time. My only compliant is that it burns a bit sometimes when I apply it. I'm not sure what might be causing a burning sensation, however it is a very slight burning sensation. I also haven't noticed any improvement but with these products it takes a while for it to start working.
After using this product for a month, I can definitely say it has made a huge difference in my dark under eyes! I'm always in my computer studying and barely get any sleep. This is a game changer!

avis.titre: Pretty good stuff for eye puffiness
avis.texte: I like that this was fragrance free. Finally! We don't need added fragrance to our products, so I appreciated that. It comes in a nice glass container which I also love. It seemed to help pretty well with my eye puffiness. I think it just took an hour or so for me to notice it working.

I have pretty noticeable puffy/dark circles under my eyes. I've been using this product at night and when I wake up in the morning and I can say I notice a difference. I look well rested and awake. This is definitely apart of my skin care routine from here on out!

I absolutely love using this eye cream because of how smooth it goes on and sinks into my dry skin. It heals my undereye bags and dark circles in less than a weeks worth of use. I am very very impressed by this.

This is the first eye cream I have ever liked! I suffer from the worst dark circles and constantly look tired even when I'm feeling perfectly fine. And after using this product I'm already noticing a difference. The cream is lightweight and feels so hydrating as soon as applied. I would definitely recommend for anyone who suffers from dark circles or undereye puffiness

I've been working longer hours at work and my under eyes started to appear tired and puffy so I was in the market for an under eye cream specifically something that contained caffeine. I have been using this product for a little while now and oh boy has it made a difference. I normally put it in the morning and let it dry for 10 to 15 minutes before applying under eye concealer. I have not had any issues with applying it under make up, and after 30 minutes or so I can really notice the difference, my under eyes seem less puffy and brighter. After I run out of this bottle, I am planning on purchasing a bigger size.
I have been using this eye cream for a couple weeks now and am enjoying it. I definitely think it helps with my eye bags and helps to bring my eyes to life in the morning. Will keep using!

Always, I have dark eyes circles. I'm always looking for something to freshen up my under eyes. I like that the product has caffeine in it reduce my dark circles. I like the product so far but feel like I have to use it more to see the results that I want

avis.titre: Excellent eye cream for tired eyes
avis.texte: I recently switched to this as my new go to eye cream over from Kiehls. I like the way this applies and is absorbed into the skin as it's light and keeps your eyes feeling awake and refreshed. After a week I could already tell a big difference.

This is a great product I needed something that was moisturizing and would help with the bit of puffiness I was getting. It fees very good and cooling while giving you a slight tingling sensation due to the caffeine in the product. Very pleased with the results and feel of this product.

As an influenster, I couldn't wait to try the Neutrogena Hydro Boost + Caffeine Eye Gel Cream, and it didn't disappoint. The lightweight gel formula feels incredibly refreshing and instantly hydrates the delicate under-eye area. Within days, I noticed a reduction in puffiness and a brighter, more awake look, even on mornings when I didn't get enough sleep. It absorbs quickly without leaving any residue, making it perfect to wear under makeup. The added caffeine is a game-changer for combating tired eyes. If you're looking for an affordable, effective eye cream that delivers results, this one is worth adding to your routine!

This is a very nice gel eye cream. It feels cooling going on. It's very lightweight and not heavy. It's very easy to apply and tap into the eye. I'm not sure if it really helped with dark circles or anything, but it is a very nice hydrating under eye gel

I have only use this for a couple of nights and mornings, so I do not Know whether it really reduces dark eye circles, long-term. However, it doesn't dry fully on the skin, leaving somewhat of a stickiness on my face. Not a huge fan of the feeling.

The Neutrogena Hydro Boost + Caffeine Eye Gel Cream is lightweight, hydrating, and perfect for everyday use. It's unscented as described, feels great going on my under-eyes, and dries super quickly with no residue left behind. This eye cream makes my under-eyes feel less dry and puffy - will definitely make this product my new go-to for eye cream.
I really liked the product and saw positive results the texture of the cream does not feel heavy very easy to apply thank you very much for sending me the product for free it has served me a lot

Neutrogena Hydra Boost + Caffeine Eye Gel Cream is a fantastic and affordable eye cream. The product packaging is high quality for how affordable the product is. You don't need much when applying as a little goes a long way. Highly recommend if you're looking for a new eye cream and don't want to break the bank.

The packaging looks nice and clean. The product was white smooth feeling. It didn't have any fragrancy. I put the product in my bathroom and used it every morning. I noticed that my eyes were getting softer. My darkness under my eyes looks the same or it could be the lighting. I would recommend this to people with dry skin under the eyes. I wouldn't change this product.
Made my face feel amazing and smooth great smell didn't look like i had anything on wasn't greasy great to wear by it's slef or under make up a little bit goes a long way

I recently began using the Neutrogena Hydro Boost Caffeine Gel, and I'm absolutely loving it! This gel is incredibly lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling refreshed and hydrated without any greasy residue. The fact that it's fragrance-free is a major plus for me, as I have sensitive skin. I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's texture and brightness, which I attribute to the energizing properties of caffeine. It's perfect for those early mornings when I need an extra boost! Overall, this product has become a staple in my skincare routine. If you're looking for a hydrating gel that revitalizes the skin and feels great, I highly recommend giving this one a try!

avis.titre: Definitely reduced my puffy eye bags
avis.texte: I've been using this cream for a week straight in the morning as I moisturize. I have been taking pictures before and about an hour after I use it and I definitely see my bags getting less puffy! There is also a nice sensation when you apply kind of cooling and soothing. I really like it!

I've always liked Neutrogena products and this is no exception. It truly is fragrance free, which is great for sensitive skin. It does not take much product at all and the little jar will last quite a while. My eye area feels hydrated but not greasy when I use this and I do think it appears a bit more plump after using it as well.

Very nourishing for the under eye - thought it was going to be thick but actually easy to spread and noticed under eye area is very hydrated. My concealer doesn't crease as much as I use this. I didn't notice much difference yet on my dark circles though. Also I would prefer if the eye cream came in a tube/pump so the cream isn't exposed every time I use it

I've been using Neutrogena Hydro Boost + Caffeine Eye Gel Cream for a few weeks now, and I'm really impressed! The gel has a refreshing, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly and leaves my under-eye area feeling hydrated and smooth. I've noticed a reduction in puffiness and a more awake, refreshed look, especially in the mornings. It also doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, which is a huge plus. Overall, it's become a staple in my skincare routine for brightening and revitalizing my eyes!

I've been testing this cream for over a week and I can already see some improvements in puffiness and dark circles, which I struggle with. It's a lightweight cream that quickly absorbs and leaves skin moisturized thanks to the hyaluronic acid. Love that it's made with clean ingredients and fragrance-free.

This is an amazing eye gel cream from Neutrogena with hyaluronic acid, caffeine, and peptide complex to help reduce fine lines, wrinkles, and puffiness. The consistency is light and feels so good underneath the eyes. I've used this gel cream for a week now and I've noticed certain lines under my eyes are less noticeable and my under eyes appear much brighter. Neutrogena is a great brand for skincare

I tried this eye cream and I must say I'm very pleased with the results. My dark circles have seemed less dominant and appears to be minimal. I'm very pleased with texture. The consistency is amazing, gel like which is very hydrating and moisturizing. It has helped my dark circles and puffiness tremendously. There are also no dry patches under my concealer. I'm very pleased! Great product!
Feels very nice on eyes at first then goes away after about 10 minutes. Great for undereye hydration but no other effects. Would be cool to see product in a dropper for better measurement.

I think it works for the most part. My eyes looked brighter and more well rested. You can actually feel the product working. I've never used an eye cream but I don't think it did much on the wrinkles part.

I really enjoyed this cream. It has so many great ingredients which includes caffeine. I need it especially with all my puffiness and dark circles. I absolutely loved the texture and the gel like consistency. I loved how cool it fell under my eyes. I love using it and hope to use it as a daily basis. I love it.

avis.titre: I have been loving this eye cream!
avis.texte: This eye cream is in my top 3 favorites. Let's just start off by saying it's affordable and found at the drug store. Secondly it's scent free and lightweight.. making it perfect for underneath makeup. I did notice a difference in the brightness of my under eyes when I used it. Definitely a great choice for morning skincare routine.

Love a good eye cream! This one has the added benefit of caffeine, which I find sometimes picks my eyes up from sleepy to awake. While I prefer a pump, this cream came in a jar so I used a mini spatula to extract product. Don't like to stick my fingers in a "pot" style container. This eye cream also contains hyaluronic acid.

Honestly it provided better results than expected. Definitely provided hydration for my under eye area. The tignetness it added to the area is what I like most, although I can't tell tell yet if it'll provided permanent firmness overtime. I hope so.

After using the Neutrogena HydroBoost Caffeine Eye Gel Cream for over two weeks day and night, I can honestly say it has not improved my dark circles. However, it does leave my undereyes looking more hydrated and lessens the puffiness. I've had no skin reaction to this eye gel cream which is good. The cream is easy to apply and lightweight around the eyes.

I really liked this product. I had some dark circles developing under my eyes, and this helped hip them in the bud. Gave me a brighter eye and kept the area hydrated without getting greasy. The formula is almost gel like and absorbed in very well.

My skin is sensitive and can react with redness. A big plus is that the cream is fragrance-free, as fragrances can trigger allergic reactions. In the first few days after applying the cream, I felt a slight tingling sensation that passed within a few seconds. Now my skin reacts well, and I'm happy about that. The cream is lightweight and provides good hydration.

This is a great eye cream. It's a little bottle but a tiny dab goes a long way. It feels really nice going on and I feel like I have seen an improvement in the way that I look. I look more fresh and awake in my eyes. I've seen improvements in the tightness for sure. I will probably buy this again and continue to use it.

While I found the packaging of this product to be a bit excessive, and the "tamper-proof seal" wouldn't deter a child, the product itself is great. It's a light moisturizer that really helped lighten the dark circles under my eyes.
This caffeine eye gel cream was okay to me. I liked that it was fragrance free and felt moisturizing but I don't see any difference for my dark under eyes.

This makes my eyes feel and look more awake and vibrant. My skin looks healthier. It gives the appearance that my skin is more boosted and overall healthier. I do think it's a great product, but I wish the size was a little larger because I like it and it goes fast!

I love Neutrogena skincare products and always have really good results. I like the ingredients in the eye cream, caffeine, hyaluronic acid, and peptide complex. My under eyes are always puffy when I wake up and I have pretty prominent dark circles. This eye cream makes my under eyes super hydrated and smoother looking. I do have some fine lines as well and it smooths the look of those. I have seen a difference in the puffiness and dark circles I have. I'm excited to keep using this to see even more long term benefits.
It is very soothing and cooling under your eyes! I recommend!

There has been quite the noticeable difference in the bags and dark circles under my eyes since I've been using Neutrogena Hydro Boost + Caffeine Eye Gel-Cream. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin with the perfect glow. This is the perfect product to add to your daily facial routine to give you the polished look that you've been looking for. I give it five stars! Thanks Neutrogena for another great product!

I love the consistency of the Neutrogena Hydro boost+caffeine eye gel cream. It absorbs quickly and I have noticed a significant difference in my undereye circles. The jar will last a long time, as a little goes a long way.
I loved using this eye cream. It hydrated my undereyes and the area around my eyes. I would have rated 5 stars if it was in a tube form and i wouldn't have to touch it everytime. Great formula though

Ive never had a good eye cream that actually works, most days i feel like a Tim Burton movie character with dark circles and bags umder my eyes with this cream i dont anymore. It really works would recommend 10000/10000

I really enjoyed using this eye cream. It felt cooling when I applied to my skin. I have been using it every night and it keeps the skin under my eyes well hydrated. I like the feeling of it going on my skin. I'll have to monitor more to see any big changes, if at all, but at the moment, I enjoy adding it as part of my night time routine.
Great product love this product leave my skin really soft and shine

Thank you Hometester for allowing me to try out this product! The best eye cream I've used. Goes on very smooth and blends easily. It really helps with the fine lines under my eyes and a little goes a long way! Neutrogena always makes products compared to high end!

avis.titre: I love how this makes my skin feel
avis.texte: This is such a gamechanger. It reminds me to apply moisturizer in the morning, due to it having caffeine. I don't end up noticing much of an effect in energy, but it definitely is a great product.

I really liked the Neutrogena hydro boost + caffeine eye cream. I have sensitive eyes and some products make my eyes tear up/irritate them. I made sure I used this product enough to give reliable feedback. It was very hydrating and made applying make up to my under eye a smooth process. After the first application, I noticed tightening almost immediately. It wasn't a permanent result but it looked great! The texture of this moisturizer is a gel without the stickiness. It's smooth and creamy and isnt oily or greasy. The only reason I gave this 4 stars instead of 5 is because it's kind of expensive for such a small amount. It does work very well, so if you're looking for an eye cream this does what it says it does. It depuffs, and tightens. I even noticed a decrease in my under eye circles!

avis.titre: Used for a week, already seeing change
avis.texte: I have been using this product for a week, and I have already started seeing the change. I see Black Spot less

This hydro eye cream gel is great for eye. I noticed that it instantly hydrated and moisturizes under eye skin. This eye gel is soft and absorbs great. I liked that it reduced skin wrinkles. I liked it and highly recommend it.

This eye cream is my favorite I've tried! It is gentle on my sensitive skin and leaves my under eyes looking refreshed and feeling moisturized. I feel like it makes me look more awake even when I have little sleep! Definitely recommend this!!

This was my first time trying this product. I really love this eye gel cream. I like that is is fragrance free. I have been using it for 1 - 2 weeks now. I feel like u see a difference in the puffy and dark circles. I would buy this again.

I struggle with puffy under eyes and was very excited to try this. I love that it had ingredients like peptide complex, hyaluronic acid, and caffeine. The eye cream is advertised to help with puffy eyes so I was excited to try it. This eye cream has a gel texture. It was very lightweight and felt very hydrating. It had no smell. I used this for a week straight and was disappointed to see that it did nothing for my under eye bags. I don't deal with dark circles so I can't comment on that. The one good thing about the eye cream was that it served as a good eye primer for under eye makeup up and concealer.

I was so ecstatic to receive this product because I have been needing an eye cream for the longest. My lack of sleep during the past year and a half postpartum has given me very tired under eyes. I saw a difference immediately upon using this and it pairs well with the hydroboost gel cream. It is very cool and gentle and has the same gel consistency which I have fallen in love with
I really enjoy this eye gel. It leaves a nice cooling sensation and the caffeine really wakes up my undereyes.

I have been using this for 2 weeks and it's so lightweight and doesn't leave my skin oilly like other products have. I have combination skin and in with these cold harsh days this has kept my dry area hydrated and not made the pils come out around my t-zone. Would definitely recommend! Great inder eue cream to use before applying makeup or before bed!
I've struggled with lines under my eyes and dark circles. This has helped with lines. Not drastically but it does help.

Neutrogena Hydro Boost+Caffeine Eye Gel Cream is a nice, lightweight treatment for the eye area. It has a similar texture to the face moisturizer from the same line and is fragrance-free. It absorbs quickly and is suitable for layering under your normal moisturizer. I used the product for 10 days and did not see any improvement in the dark circles (or semi-circles in my case) or puffiness in my under-eye area, but the skin around my eyes feels softer, more supple, and hydrated in between applications. I feel like over time, this could lead to a reduction in the appearance of my fine lines.

Neutrogena's Hydro Boost + Caffeine Eye Gel Cream awakened my eyes. I struggle with my eye area, especially during the winter time. My dry skin has enjoyed this cream thoroughly. This was gentle on my eye area and absorbed very well. My skin was kept moisturized all day or all night long. When waking up, my normal dark circles were greatly reduced. I look fresh and more awake. Completely happy and definitely recommend!
It was gentle and didn't irritate my skin. The product applies very smoothly and was easy to layer on if I wanted another coat.

Who said drug store products can't deliver? The Neutrogena Hydro Boost line has yet to disappoint. The Hydro Boost + Caffeine Eye Gel Cream is what undereyes dream off. It's so lightweight, yet sufficiently hydrating. Your undereyes immediately feel so supple. The caffeine also brightens up your eyes, almost giving an immediate awakened effect. It's an amazing eye cream!

I have been using this product for a few weeks and I will say that it helps me remove the unwanted bags and dark circles under my eyes. I think the added caffeine in it makes them go down. Definitely would consider buying this line of product in the future!

Neutrogena Hydro Boost + Caffeine Eye Gel Cream Fragrance-Free has been a fantastic addition to my skincare routine. The lightweight gel texture feels refreshing and absorbs quickly without leaving any residue, making it perfect for layering under makeup. I noticed it effectively reduced the puffiness around my eyes, and my under-eye area looked smoother and more hydrated throughout the day. The fragrance-free formula is gentle and ideal for sensitive skin. It's a go-to product when I want my eyes to look more awake and refreshed.
